text:
anya: quick heads-up noticed two places with inconsistent wording for unsaved work: the floating toast says `Unsaved changes` but the modal asks `Discard?` — can we standardize? sam: Yeah this trips people. My preference: toast = non-blocking status, modal = clear action + consequence. Draft: toast = `You have unsaved changes` modal title = `Unsaved changes` modal body = `You have unsaved changes. Save your changes or discard them. Unsaved changes will be lost.` buttons = `Save` (primary), `Discard changes` (destructive), `Keep editing` (secondary). marta: +1 to `Keep editing` instead of `Cancel` — clearer for keyboard/screen-reader users. Also prefer `Discard changes` wording rather than `Discard`. des: small design note: our pattern is primary on the right. Keep Save (right, primary), Discard (left, destructive/red), Keep editing ghost. Ensure tab order matches visual order. I'll add visible focus styles for destructive. liam: accessibility checklist: 1) toast in aria-live="polite" 2) modal traps focus, sets initial focus to heading 3) announcements reference aria-describedby for body 4) destructive button should have an aria-label like `Discard changes (cannot be undone)` if needed. anya: agree. exact strings so I can update Figma/copy repo: - toast: `You have unsaved changes` - toast with CTA: `You have unsaved changes — Save now` (CTA label `Save`) - modal title: `Unsaved changes` - modal body: `You have unsaved changes. Save your changes or discard them. Unsaved changes will be lost.` - buttons: `Save`, `Discard changes`, `Keep editing` marta: tiny nit: maybe slightly friendlier body: `You have unsaved changes. Save your work or discard it; unsaved changes will be lost.` des: either works, keep it short. devs, here's a snippet for reference: ```
You have unsaved changes

Unsaved changes

You have unsaved changes. Unsaved changes will be lost.
``` anya: design-bot, link our button tokens so I match paddings/colors? :pray: design-bot: Button patterns: https://docs.redwood.design/button-patterns (primary = right, destructive = left red, secondary ghost). marta: i'll run VoiceOver + NVDA checks after the copy lands. des: i'll own keyboard/visual QA. anya: thanks all — i'm updating the copy file and the Figma components now, will include autosave variants (autosave on -> `All changes saved`).
